name: Shattered Dream Strike [Psionic]
body:
You sap your opponent’s will with your attacks.

Prerequisites: Devastating touch class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike, Broken Dreams Style, Intimidate 6 ranks

Benefit: While in the broken dreams style, after making a successful unarmed strike empowered with your devastating touch, you can make a free Intimidate check against the target.
